07FAQ

Common questions

A virtual omnichannel platform runs AI-driven conversations across Voice, WhatsApp, Email and SMS from one system, instead of stitching together separate single-channel tools.

Voice-only platforms optimize one channel. Echophi runs Voice, WhatsApp, Email and SMS under the same quality layer, so scoring, compliance and human review work the same way everywhere a customer reaches you.

No. Echophi automates routine conversation volume and routes flagged or complex conversations to human reviewers, who also grade a sample of every channel to keep the AI accurate.

Every conversation is scored automatically for accuracy, compliance and tone; a sample is reviewed by humans; and that judgment feeds back into prompts and scoring so quality compounds over time.

Yes. Voice, WhatsApp, Email and SMS are each reachable through documented APIs and webhooks, with the same quality scoring available on every event.

Yes. Echophi supports HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2 and PCI DSS requirements, with encryption in transit and at rest and a choice of US, EU or APAC data residency.
